question: After the two concrete trust-boundary defects are repaired, should this protected signed marketplace feed stack be accepted as the core marketplace trust path or paused for a broader ClawHub/default-feed direction decision?
rationale: The patch changes signed plugin marketplace trust, config shape, and persisted snapshot state; automated review can identify the required repairs, but maintainers own the final trust-model and rollout decision.

options.title: Repair In Place, Then Security Review
options.body: Fix rollback and URL-override bypasses on this branch, rerun the focused trust/state validation, and keep final merge behind maintainer/security acceptance.

options.title: Pause For Trust Direction
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide the complete ClawHub signing, default-feed key distribution, and operator configuration direction across the stack.

options.title: Reject The Core Surface
options.body: Close the stack if maintainers decide signed marketplace feed verification should not live in OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Repair In Place, Then Security Review
recommendation.body: Fix rollback and URL-override bypasses on this branch, rerun the focused trust/state validation, and keep final merge behind maintainer/security acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned on the live PR and has already reviewed the exact trust-boundary issues that need final maintainer/security disposition.
